title: Dataset of damaged photovoltaic cells electroluminescence, visible and near-infrared multispectral images with performance degradation data and LLM-RAG descriptors
mechanism: Pixel-aligned EL, NIR and visible HDR images of the same cells after staged mechanical, thermal and electrical damage, with Isc / Voc per stage.
adaptation: Use abrasion / scrape stages to see how surface scuffs look in EL versus real cracks, as hard negatives for E1 scuff streaks; tiny severity check of predicted inactive fraction vs Isc drop. Test-only (one poly cell type).
min_experiment: Visual check that abrasion EL resembles E1 scuffs; if yes, paste as background-labelled negatives. Arm vs PF on E1 crack relP@2 in half-cut cells. Kill at the visual check or if relP@2 < +0.02. Download needs user OK.
evidence: R: small number of polycrystalline cells, same camera for NIR and EL gives near pixel-perfect registration; CC BY.
prior_overlap: Partial: scuff as its own class (649 px) was not learned; hard negatives from a registered external set were not tried.
